_comment: The dungeon tile registry — template DATA (P0 paper P.6.3; P.9 G1/G2), the sibling of the platformer's tile_types.json with the same row shape plus color_role. Only cell VALUES that are tile types live here: -1 (event) and >= 2000 (item id) are placements, never tiles, and -2 (door) is runtime-only and never on disk. tile_px is the engine's GRID_SIZE (P.6.2 row 17). palette.background names a cradle theme token (the open cell takes the app surface); wall_by_environment is the engine's WALL_COLORS table verbatim — an environment it does not name takes wall_fallback, exactly as the engine does (P.9 S8). markers are the block-mode placeholder colours for placements that carry no environment tint of their own.
